'''Kiros''' was an idyllic [[Planet/Legends|world]] filled with vast green valleys and flowing waterfalls. Located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], the planet served as the site of a colony of [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Artist/Legends|artists]].

==History==
[[File:KirosLandscape-Kidnapped.png|thumb|left|200px|Cliffside Togruta colony during the Clone Wars]]
The world was host to 50,000 Togruta colonists.<ref name="EG411" /> The planet was ruled by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Roshti/Legends|Roshti]], who was contacted by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] just prior to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] occupation of Kiros during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="CW1" />

[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] approached the governor of the world to allow the Separatists to move the population to a secure location while they established a base there. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] later fought a [[Battle of Kiros|battle]] on Kiros, where they liberated the planet but discovered that the entire population had been taken by slavers.<ref name="CW1" />

After [[Battle of Kadavo/Legends|the battle]] at [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]] had ended and the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|slave processing facility]] was destroyed, the former captives were returned to Kiros, to rebuild their society. This included arming themselves and receiving combat training from [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="CW6">[[The Clone Wars 6|''The Clone Wars'' 6]]</ref>
